    from sys import stdin, stdout

    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    forbidden = set(map(int, data[2:])) if n > 0 else set()

    used = [False] * m
    sequence = []
    current_product = 1

    for i in range(m):
        if not used[i] and (current_product * i) % m not in forbidden:
            sequence.append(i)
            current_product = (current_product * i) % m
            used[i] = True

    stdout.write(f"{len(sequence)}\n")
    stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, sequence)) + "\n")

main()
